_doc: What each known bot is for, keyed by its known_bots.json pattern. purpose: one plain sentence. uses: what happens to the content (training | search | live answers | link preview | monitoring | SEO data | dataset | scraping | other). robots: what the OPERATOR says about robots.txt: honours | may ignore | not a crawler | not stated. 'not stated' means we found no statement, not that it ignores the file. token: the robots.txt user-agent to name. Edit by PR; keep claims to what the operator documents.

GPTBot.purpose: Collects public pages that may be used to train OpenAI's generative models.

OAI-SearchBot.purpose: Indexes pages so they can appear as sources in ChatGPT search answers.

ChatGPT-User.purpose: Fetches a page when a ChatGPT user (or a custom GPT) asks about it; not used for automatic crawling.
ChatGPT-User.note: OpenAI: because a user starts these requests, robots.txt rules may not apply.

ClaudeBot.purpose: Collects public pages that may be used to train Anthropic's Claude models.

Claude-SearchBot.purpose: Indexes pages to improve the quality of Claude's search results.

Claude-User.purpose: Fetches a page when a Claude user asks a question that needs it.

anthropic-ai.purpose: Older Anthropic user-agent, superseded by ClaudeBot.

Google-Extended.purpose: Not a separate crawler: a robots.txt token that controls whether pages Google crawls may be used for Gemini and Vertex AI.

GoogleOther.purpose: Google's generic crawler for internal research and product development fetches.

Googlebot.purpose: Crawls pages for Google Search, including what feeds AI Overviews.

Google-CloudVertexBot.purpose: Crawls sites at the site owner's request to build Vertex AI agents.

AdsBot-Google.purpose: Checks landing pages of Google Ads for quality.
AdsBot-Google.note: Ignores the * group; must be named explicitly.

Google-InspectionTool.purpose: Fetches a page when someone uses Search Console's URL inspection or Rich Results test.

Storebot-Google.purpose: Crawls product pages for Google Shopping.

PerplexityBot.purpose: Indexes pages so they can be cited in Perplexity's answers.

Perplexity-User.purpose: Fetches a page when a Perplexity user asks about it.
Perplexity-User.note: Perplexity: since a user requested the fetch, it generally ignores robots.txt.

Bytespider.purpose: ByteDance's crawler; widely reported to gather data for its AI models.

CCBot.purpose: Builds Common Crawl, the free web archive most large language models have been trained on.

Meta-ExternalAgent.purpose: Crawls pages that may be used to train Meta's AI models or to index content for them.

Meta-ExternalFetcher.purpose: Fetches a page on behalf of a user of Meta's AI products.
Meta-ExternalFetcher.note: Meta: because a user starts the fetch, it may bypass robots.txt.

FacebookBot.purpose: Older Meta crawler associated with improving its language models.

facebookexternalhit.purpose: Builds the preview card when a link is shared on Facebook, Instagram or Messenger.
facebookexternalhit.note: Meta: may bypass robots.txt for security and integrity checks.

Amazonbot.purpose: Crawls pages to improve Amazon products and services, including Alexa answers.

Applebot-Extended.purpose: Not a separate crawler: a robots.txt token that controls whether Applebot's pages may train Apple's foundation models.

Applebot.purpose: Crawls pages for Siri, Spotlight and Safari suggestions.

bingbot.purpose: Crawls pages for Bing search, which also grounds Microsoft Copilot answers.

DuckAssistBot.purpose: Fetches pages to answer questions in DuckDuckGo's DuckAssist.

cohere-ai.purpose: Fetches pages for Cohere's AI products, typically when a user's request needs them.

Diffbot.purpose: Extracts structured data from pages for Diffbot's knowledge graph and APIs.

YouBot.purpose: Crawls pages for You.com's AI search.

MistralAI-User.purpose: Fetches a page when a Le Chat user's request needs it.

PetalBot.purpose: Crawls pages for Huawei's Petal Search.

Timpibot.purpose: Crawls pages for Timpi's decentralised search index.

omgili.purpose: Webz.io crawler that collects forum and discussion content for its data feeds.

Webzio-Extended.purpose: Webz.io token covering use of crawled content for AI training datasets.

img2dataset.purpose: Open-source tool used to download images in bulk for training datasets.

AI2Bot.purpose: Allen Institute for AI crawler collecting pages for open research models.

Ai2Bot-Dolma.purpose: Allen Institute for AI crawler building the open Dolma training dataset.

iaskspider.purpose: Crawls pages for the iAsk AI search engine.

Kangaroo Bot.purpose: Crawler collecting pages for AI training.

PanguBot.purpose: Huawei crawler associated with its PanGu AI models.

Scrapy.purpose: An open-source scraping framework; who runs it and why is unknown.
Scrapy.note: Scrapy obeys robots.txt only if the person running it enables that.

SemrushBot.purpose: Crawls pages for Semrush's SEO and backlink data.

AhrefsBot.purpose: Crawls pages for Ahrefs' backlink and SEO database.

DataForSeoBot.purpose: Crawls pages for DataForSEO's SEO data APIs.

MJ12bot.purpose: Crawls pages for Majestic's backlink index.

DotBot.purpose: Crawls pages for Moz's link index.

BLEXBot.purpose: Crawls pages for WebMeUp's backlink data.

serpstatbot.purpose: Crawls pages for Serpstat's SEO data.

QualifiedBot.purpose: Fetches pages for Qualified's AI sales assistant.

Devin.purpose: Cognition's AI software engineer, browsing while it works on a task.

Brightbot.purpose: Bright Data's crawler; the company sells web data and scraping infrastructure.

SeznamBot.purpose: Crawls pages for Seznam, the Czech search engine.

Slackbot.purpose: Builds the preview when a link is posted in Slack.

Discordbot.purpose: Builds the preview when a link is posted in Discord.

WhatsApp.purpose: Builds the preview when a link is shared in WhatsApp.

TelegramBot.purpose: Builds the preview when a link is shared in Telegram.

Twitterbot.purpose: Builds the card when a link is shared on X (Twitter).

LinkedInBot.purpose: Builds the preview when a link is shared on LinkedIn.

Pinterestbot.purpose: Crawls pages and images for Pinterest.

UptimeRobot.purpose: Checks that a site is up, for whoever set up the monitor (often the site owner).

Pingdom.com_bot.purpose: Checks that a site is up for a Pingdom monitoring customer.
